text: Battery electric vehicle fleet charging strategy and infrastructure • Station/curbfront configurations and operations • Systems engineering methodology for analysis and assessment. The content of this third edition report is organized into four sections which provide the foundational background from the prior two editions and a summary of the Phase III research findings. Included in this overview is an introduction and functional definition of an AMD that brackets all three editions. The 10 early site deployments are identified, with updates given for select sites along with a summary and discussion of Phase II cardinal principles. The last section is a summary of Phase III research that spans the topic areas above. The editions that follow in the AMD implementation report series will address the details of these Phase III research topics; this material serves as “primer”-level material on the basic elements of AV fleet deployment within an AMD. These subsequent editions will present the base material for the insights and conclusions related to on-demand transit operations, electrification of the AV fleet, station design, and system operational impacts of AVs. A brief synopsis of the AMD implementation research program that provides a high-level summary of what is covered in this third edition overview report has also been published, available at docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/93107.pdf. iii This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies at www.nlr.gov/publications.
